title: ר' יוחנן בן החורנית

paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan ben HaChoranit: the elders of the House of Shammai and House of Hillel went to visit him. Mishnah, Sukkah 2:7 (28a); Eruvin 13b. In Yevamot 14b: ‘If we follow the House of Shammai,’ and so forth. Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel told him: ‘What shall we do,’ and so forth. Rabbi Elazar be-Rabbi Tzadok said: ‘When I was learning Torah with Rabbi Yochanan ben HaChoranit, I saw that he ate dry bread in years of famine, and I told my father’: Yevamot 15b and Tosefta, Sukkah, chapter 2.
